mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notifications (recipient_id, sender_id, notification_type, post_id, is_read, created_at) VALUES (#{recipientId}, #{senderId}, #{notificationType}, #{postId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, FALSE, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.select: SELECT user_nickname AS nickname, user_icon AS icon FROM users WHERE user_id = #{userId}

SELECT s.track_name AS trackName, r.reaction_emoji AS reactionEmoji, s.artwork_url AS artworkUrl FROM posts p JOIN songs s ON s.song_id = p.song_id LEFT JOIN reactions r ON r.post_id = p.post_id AND r.user_id = #{userId} WHERE p.post_id = #{postId}

SELECT requester_id AS user_id FROM friends WHERE receiver_id = #{posterId} AND friend_status = 1 AND requester_notify_on_post = TRUE UNION ALL SELECT receiver_id AS user_id FROM friends WHERE requester_id = #{posterId} AND friend_status = 1 AND receiver_notify_on_post = TRUE

SELECT n.notification_id, n.recipient_id, n.sender_id, n.notification_type, n.post_id, n.is_read, n.created_at, u.user_nickname AS sender_nickname, u.user_icon AS sender_icon, s.track_name AS track_name, r.reaction_emoji AS reaction_emoji FROM notifications n JOIN users u ON u.user_id = n.sender_id LEFT JOIN posts p ON p.post_id = n.post_id LEFT JOIN songs s ON s.song_id = p.song_id LEFT JOIN reactions r ON r.post_id = n.post_id AND r.user_id = n.sender_id WHERE n.recipient_id = #{recipientId} ORDER BY n.notification_id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notifications WHERE recipient_id = #{recipientId} AND is_read = FALSE
